sources.scope: Official Naver conversion installation guide links this SDK and explains configured wa as a site common key. It does not publish the collector field/rejection protocol.

Default wcs_SerName is wcs.naver.com. Function j constructs /m with u/e, configured i/wa, optional ur/fwb/ui/ext, and vs/nt. pageviewOld and eventOld use image transport I. Function N separately sends JSON strings to /b using sendBeacon.

independent_constructors: pageviewOld calls j, then appends pageview/custom fields and dispatches with image transport I.
eventOld calls j, adds event/category/action and dispatches with image transport I.
implemented_advisories: Nonempty generated u/vs/nt in the default-host query profile
A submitted wa must be nonempty at warning severity only
Captured query transport method should match the SDK GET image profile
explicit_nonrequirements: No mandatory wa or invented i/wa equivalence
No ID alphabet, clock grammar, timestamp bounds, event enum or server rejection claim
No query validation borrowed by POST /b or loader URLs
